sources.title: Greater London Authority London Datastore
sources.licence: London Datastore terms; dataset-level licence and attribution required
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the Greater London Authority and dataset publisher; state that GLA cannot warrant quality or accuracy where required.
sources.provenance_notes: Record dataset page, resource URL, modified date, licence, and checksum.
caveats: Review dataset-specific terms before publishing derived artifacts.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap full-history analytics via ohsome API
sources.provider: HeiGIT ohsome API using OpenStreetMap history
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0 for OSM-derived data
sources.update_frequency: Service-dependent; query metadata must record temporal filter and retrieval timestamp.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute OpenStreetMap contributors and retain ohsome query metadata.
sources.provenance_notes: Recommended source for reproducible OSM history snapshots and counts.
caveats: Historical OSM presence reflects mapper activity and source availability as well as real-world change.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap extracts via Overpass API
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
sources.update_frequency: Continuous community edits; extract currency depends on retrieval timestamp.
sources.attribution_text: Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under ODbL.
sources.provenance_notes: Store Overpass query, bbox, endpoint, retrieval timestamp, element id, version, changeset, and OSM timestamp. OSM edit timestamps are mapped visibility dates, not direct construction dates.
caveats: Do not present OSM edit dates as real-world opening or construction dates.

sources.title: Planning London Datahub
sources.provider: Greater London Authority and London Planning Authorities
sources.licence: Public access with dataset/layer-specific terms; verify before redistribution
sources.update_frequency: Daily updates during the decision process.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Greater London Authority, relevant London Planning Authority, and any dataset/layer-specific copyright notices.
sources.provenance_notes: Store application id, planning authority, validation/decision dates, API query, retrieval timestamp, and quality flags.
caveats: Applicant-supplied records can be amended during quality review; preserve update timestamps.

sources.title: Transport for London open data
sources.licence: TfL transport data terms and conditions
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Transport for London and comply with TfL transport data terms.
sources.provenance_notes: Record feed URL, endpoint, request parameters, response timestamp, and terms.
caveats: Use current feeds as current-state context unless archived snapshots are available.
